title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Duo #10 (L:부채꼴·물결 / C:가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Filipina woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, sultry, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 51% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 2 o'clock, 4 o'clock and 10 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense jewel-toned scenework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform square-toe heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, bold and confident, soft pastel-peach hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 24% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, dense floral medallion border filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
